about:
Top Notch Sheet Metal, a family-owned custom sheet metal fabrication shop, was established in 2005 in Covington, Kentucky. The business began with a team of experienced metal craftsmen bringing over a century of combined experience in sheet metal fabrication, custom stainless steel work, design, and installation.

The company provides a broad range of metalworking services including laser cutting and etching, CNC plasma cutting, CNC water jet cutting (with a five-axis OMAX MAXIEM Water Jet), welding, forming, rolling, stamping, and shearing and bending up to 12 feet. It produces commercial and residential kitchen hoods, HVAC ventilation and air handling solutions, glazing products, roof curbs and flashing, door frames, hoppers, chutes, machine guards, window guards, and Lexan protective shielding. The shop works with aluminum, copper, galvanized steel, stainless steel, brass, hot and cold rolled steel, as well as composites, glass, and plastics.

Top Notch serves the food processing and kitchen equipment industries, HVAC and ducting contractors, foundries, iron works, glazing contractors, marine fabricators, and roofing specialists. Its custom stainless steel kitchens, machine guards, and architectural metalwork are installed in commercial, industrial, and residential projects throughout the region.

The company emphasizes guaranteed high-quality customer service as its primary differentiator, building lasting relationships that drive repeat business and referrals. The recent addition of the OMAX MAXIEM Water Jet expanded its capability to cut, bevel, chamfer, and etch a wider variety of materials and thicknesses, further supporting its customer-focused approach.
